trace.question: give me the activity count based on the reps

tasks.sql:
WITH rpt_activities AS (
SELECT src.id, src.organization_id, src.activity_source, src.deal_id, src.contact_id, src.type, src.subject, src.body, src.task_status, src.due_at, src.completed_at, src.performed_by_user_id, src.assignee_user_id, src.created_at FROM (
SELECT 
  id,
  organization_id,
  activity_source,
  deal_id,
  contact_id,
  type,
  subject,
  body,
  task_status,
  due_at,
  completed_at,
  performed_by_user_id,
  assignee_user_id,
  created_at
FROM (
  SELECT 
    da.id,
    da.organization_id,
    'deal' AS activity_source,
    da.deal_id,
    NULL::text AS contact_id,
    da.type::text AS type,
    da.subject,
    da.body,
    NULL::text AS task_status,
    da.due_at,
    da.completed_at,
    da.created_by_user_id AS performed_by_user_id,
    NULL::bigint AS assignee_user_id,
    da.created_at
  FROM crm.deal_activities da
  WHERE da.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    ca.id,
    ca.organization_id,
    'contact' AS activity_source,
    NULL::text AS deal_id,
    ca.contact_id,
    ca.type::text AS type,
    ca.subject,
    ca.body,
    ca.task_status::text AS task_status,
    ca.due_at,
    ca.completed_at,
    ca.created_by_user_id AS performed_by_user_id,
    ca.assignee_user_id,
    ca.created_at
  FROM crm.contact_activities ca
  WHERE ca.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) u
) src WHERE TRUE
)
SELECT type AS activity_type, CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS activity_count FROM rpt_activities AS activities WHERE TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE GROUP BY type ORDER BY activity_count DESC LIMIT 500
